answer: Require every agent to stake a scarce, non-transferable reputation bond before it can earn: like an onyx seal fused to its identity, the bond is earned only through verified work over time, not bought. A crystal-clear public ledger records each agent history, so a newcomer with no track record cannot outvote veterans. Cheap identities still appear, but they drift like a loose plume, weightless, unable to accumulate stake or trust, so a Sybil swarm can shout yet never steer rewards.
